info.title: KPMG Origins API
info.description:
- How to authenticate - Definitions of Key API Endpoints - Other Information KPMG Origins provides customers with access to their data, and data shared with them, through APIs. The APIs allow customers with the ability to create, update and extract available data.
## How to authenticate 1) Create API credentials via KPMG Origins UI (NB: only users with the Administrator role can manage API credentials): - Login to KPMG Origins - Go to Settings page, then API Credentials tab - Create API credentials - Copy the Client Id and Secret (NB: you will not be able to recover the secret value if lost, however, you can generate a new one) 2) Exchange API Credentials for a short-lived _access token_ - Make a POST request to **https://<KPMG Origins hostname>/cr/client-api/v1/token** ``` { "clientId": "", "secret": "" } ``` 3) Make authenticated requests to KPMG Origins API: - Use the access token value form the token API response as a Bearer token to make requests to the API i.e. set Authorization header like this: `Authorization: Bearer ` ``` NB: access token is only valid for a short time, if requests start failing with 401 status code, repeat steps 2) and 3) ```
## Definitions of Key API Endpoints This section explains key definitions of key data entities and API endpoints * **Organisation**: the organisation can either be an organisation or an individual. - An *organisation* is a participant which usually holds an ABN or ACN, usually an entity participating in commercial activities. - An *individual* is a participant who has no ABN or ACN. For example, in Movement, a generator who is a private individual (e.g. residential asbestos pick-up). This distinction is necessary as it relates to a validation in the ``post organisation`` API. * **Location**: locations represent geographical sites which are operated by organisations. Each location possesses a unique location ID to distinguish it from other locations in the system, as well as an organisation / client ID that specifies which organisation operates it. Please see the details on each individual API to learn more about the specific criteria needed for a successful payload.
## Other Information - The format for Client Id mentioned in the APIs is ``IDType.IDValue`` - By default, the collection of items returned can include up to 10,000 items, but this can be changed via the ``Limit`` and ``Skip`` parameters.

post.description: ### Creates a New Location ### This API allows users to create a new location in the KPMG Origins platform. The User must specify the organisation that is the owner or custodian of the location. Field Name | Description | Mandatory | Data Type / Format | Example ---|---|---|---|--- id | The internal identifier of the location that was created by the client. If one is not provided, one will be auto-generated for that location. | | [ID_Type].[ID_Value] | LOC.123456789 organisationId | The **Organisation / Client ID** of the organisation. The User can provide their own Organisation / Cient ID. In addition, they can creating a location on behalf of another organisation. | Mandatory | [ID_Type].[ID_Value] | ABN.12345678910 name | The name of the location. | Mandatory | String | Sample Co Sydney Processing Plant countryCode | The three digit country code of the location. | Mandatory | String | AUS city | The city where the location is situated. | Mandatory | String | Sydney address | The address where the location is situated (excluding city, state, and postcode). | Mandatory | String | Unit 5, 78 Avalon Avenue postcode | The postcode where the location is situated. | Mandatory | String | 2000 state | The State where the location is situated. | Mandatory | String | NSW longitude | The longitude where the location is situated. | Mandatory | number | -33.865144 latitude | The latitude where the location is situated. | Mandatory | number | 151.202132 timezone | The timezone where the location is situated. | Mandatory | String | UTC+10:00: Sydney otherIds | Any other alternative internal identifiers of the location. | | [ID_Type].[ID_Value] | SAMPLELOC.123456789 googlePlaceId | The google place ID of the location. | | String | ChIJgUbEo8cfqokR5lP9_Wh_DaM geoData | The geo json data of the location. | | JObject | {"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[{"type":"Feature","properties":{"Producer Name":"Producer 2","Producer Country":"US","Production Place Name":"place 4"},"geometry":{"coordinates":[[[-104.5982275585944,40.0864026500478],[-104.71940938616444,39.88138559039132],[-104.51166910773692,39.805173411506104],[-103.91164152130597,39.8356005398515],[-104.03282334887601,39.97464425984117],[-104.32279415056169,40.083693499590936],[-104.5982275585944,40.0864026500478]]],"type":"Polygon"},"id":0}]}

get.summary: Retrieve Locations Based on the Specified Filter
get.description:
### Retrieve Locations Based on the Specified Filter ### This API allows users to get a list of all locations based on the specified filters. The five filters are: Field Name | Description | Data Type / Format | Example ---|---|---|--- ids | Search sections of the string of the location ID. | [ID_Type].[ID_Value] | LOC.12 search | Specifies the string that must appear in the location name in the response. Note that a minimum of 4 characters is required. The API searches through: **Name**, **City**, **Country Name** and **Address**
| String | Sample Co Sydney archived | Specifies whether or not the location has been archived. | String | Unarchived limit | Specifies the maximum number of items or records that should be included in the response. | Integer(number) | 10 skip | specifies the offset or starting point from where the API should begin returning the results. It specifies the number of items or records that should be skipped or ignored before returning the requested data, and is useful for navigating to different pages or datasets in the result. | Integer(number) | 0 useFuzzyMatching | (Optional) use fuzzy matching on Address field, could extended to the fields in future. | Boolean | True/False Therefore, a sample request specifying for: * 10000 entries in the response, AND * with zero skipped entries, AND * where the Location ID is "gln.5149730576176", AND * where the location is **unarchived**, AND * the search term is **sample** Sample request: GET locations/query?search=Australia&ids=gln.5149730576176&limit=10000&skip=0;search=sample;archived=UnArchived

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: The specific string to detect in the location name.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether or not this location is archived.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of entries permitted in the response.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: The number of entries to skip in the response.

parameters.name: useFuzzyMatching
parameters.description: (Optional) Use fuzzy matching on Address field (could be extended to other fields in future).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Extra data to include in the response.

200.description: Returns the list of locations based on the provided filter

patch.description: ### Updates an Existing Location ### This API allows users to update an existing location in the KPMG Origins platform. The user must specify the client id of the location. The user can update locations of organisation they are associated with. Field Name | Description | Data Type / Format | Example ---|---|---|--- Name | The name of the location. | String | Sample Co Sydney Processing Plant CountryCode | The three digit country code of the location. | String | AUS City | The city where the location is situated. | String | Sydney Address | The address where the location is situated (excluding city, state, and postcode). | String | Unit 5, 78 Avalon Avenue Postcode | The postcode where the location is situated. | String | 2000 State | The State where the location is situated. | String | NSW Longitude | The longitude where the location is situated. | number | -33.865144 Latitude | The latitude where the location is situated. | number | 151.202132 TimeZone | The timezone where the location is situated. | String | UTC+10:00: Sydney OtherIds | Any other alternative internal identifiers of the location. | [ID_Type].[ID_Value] | SAMPLELOC.123456789 GooglePlaceId | The google place ID of the location. | String | ChIJgUbEo8cfqokR5lP9_Wh_DaM Email | The email linked to the location. | String | location@test.kpmgorigins.com The sample request will be drafted as: ``` [ { "path": "/State", "op": "replace", "from": "NSW", "value": "QLD" }, { "path": "/Email", "op": "replace", "from": "location@test.kpmgorigins.com", "value": "location-2@test.kpmgorigins.com" } ] ```

parameters.description: Client id of the location to update

get.summary: Retrieves a Location by Location ID
get.description:
### Retrieves a Location by a Location ID ###
This API allows users to search for details on a location by providing the location ID.
            
The format for location ID is:
            
    [ID_Type].[ID_Value]
            
For example, the location ID listed below would qualify for the required syntax:
            
    LOC.123456789
            
Sample request:
            
    GET locations/LOC.123456789

200.description: Returns the list of locations based on the provided filter.

get.summary: Retrieve Organisation by Organisation / Client ID
get.description:
### Retrieve organisations based on Organisation / Client ID ###
This API allows users to search for details of an organisation by providing an organisation ID. This identifier may be referred to as "organisation ID" or "client ID" in different parts of the documentation; they refer to the same unique identifer for organisations or individuals. For organisations, this is commonly an ABN or an ACN.
 The format for organisation ID is:

     [ID_Type].[ID_Value]

 For example, organisations IDs listed below would qualify for the required syntax:

     ORGID.012345678, ABN.12345678910

 Therefore, a sample request will appear as follows:

     GET organization/ABN.12345678910

get.summary: Retrieve Organisations Based on the Specified Filter
get.description:
### Retrieve Organisations Based on the Specified Filter ###
            
This API allows Users to get all organisation(s) based on the specific filter. Based on the filter, a list of organisation is returned as a collection.
            
Key details are as follows:
Field Name | Description | Data Type / Format | Example
---|---|---|---
Limit | Specifies the maximum number of items or records that should be included in the response. | number | 10
Skip | Specifies the offset or starting point from where the API should begin returning the results. It specifies the number of items or records that should be skipped or ignored before returning the requested data, and is useful for navigating to different pages or chunks of data in a result set. | number | 0
searchTerm | Specifies the string that must appear in the organisation name in the response. Note that a minimum of 5 characters is required. The API searches through: 
**commonName**, **legalName**, **fullAddress**, **countryName**, **clientID**</br>| number | Sample Co
            
Therefore, a sample request specifying for:
            
* 100 entries in the response, AND
* with zero skipped entries, AND
* where the organisation name is "organisation name"
            
will be written as the following:
            
    GET organizations?limit=100&skip=0&searchTerm=organisation%20name

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of entries permitted in the response.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: The number of entries to skip in the response.

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: The specific string to detect in the organisation name.

patch.description:
### Updates an Existing Organization ###

 This API allows users to update an existing organization in the KPMG Origins platform. The user must specify the client id of the organization.
 | Field Name | Description | Data Type / Format | Example |
 |----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------------------------|
 | OrganizationType | The type of the organization. | String | Corporate |
 | LegalName | The legal name of the organization. | String | Legal Name |
 | CommonName | The common name of the organization. | String | Common Name |
 | Email | The email address of the organization. | String | organization @test.com |
 | PhoneNumber | The phone number of the organization. | String | +401862380 |
 | Website | The website URL of the organization. | String | https: //www.organization.com      |
 | IsIndividual | Whether the organization is an individual. | Boolean | false |
 | Industry | The industry the organization belongs to. | String | Technology |
 | CountryCode | The three-letter country code of the organization. | String | AUS |
 | Description | A description of the organization. | String | This is a sample organization. |
 | City | The city where the organization is located. | String | Sydney |
 | Address | The address where the organization is located. | String | 1234 Main Street |
 | Postcode | The postcode where the organization is located. | String | 2000 |
 | State | The state where the organization is located. | String | NSW |
 | Longitude | The longitude where the organization is located. | Number | -33.865144 |
 | Latitude | The latitude where the organization is located. | Number | 151.202132 |
 | GooglePlaceId | The google place ID of the organization. | String | ChIJgUbEo8cfqokR5lP9_Wh_DaM |
 | DescriptionMarkDown | A markdown description of the organization. | String | *Markdown Description* |
 | OtherIds | Any other alternative internal identifiers. | [ID_Type].[ID_Value] | SAMPLELOC .123456789 |

 #### Possible values for `OrganizationType` are:
 SystemOperator, Processor, Distributor, Certifier, Logistics, Producer

 #### Possible values for `Industry` are:
 Agriculture, Beverage, Beverages, Certification, Cosmetics, Dairy, Distributor, Ecommerce, Energy, Fashion, Food, Government, Healthcare, Import, Livestock, Logistics, Manufacturing, Medical, Oleochemicals, Packaging, Pawnshop, Pharmaceutical, Polymer, PortAuthority, PortOperator, Produce, Resources, Retail, Textiles, Transport, Waste

 The sample request will be drafted as:
```
 [
     {
         "path": "/State",
          "op": "replace",
         "from": "NSW",
         "value": "QLD"
     },
     {
         "path": "/Email",
         "op": "replace",
         "from": "location@test.kpmgorigins.com",
         "value": "location-2@test.kpmgorigins.com"
     }
 ]
```

requestBody.description: PATCH payload, only replace operations supported.

post.summary: Creates a Product Template / SKU / Material.
post.description:
### Creates a Product Template / SKU / Material ### This API allows creating a new product template. Key details are: Field Name | Description | Mandatory | Data Type / Format | Example ---|---|---|---|--- Id | The main unique identifier of the product template | Mandatory | [ID_Type].[ID_Value] | SKU.123456789 OtherIds | Other secondary ID's | Optional | Array of [ID_Type].[ID_Value] | [ WWCO.12312312, ABC.129929292 ] ParentId | The parent product template of this product template. | Optional | [ID_Type].[ID_Value] | SKU.123456789 Name | The name that describes the product or the function of the product. | Mandatory | String | Water Bottle 200ml NameLong | Long name of the product (not in use). | Optional | String | Eco-Friendly Water Bottle 200 ml Description | The detailed description of the product. | Optional | String | A reusable, eco-friendly water bottle made from BPA-free materials BrandName | The name of the brand of the product. | Optional | String | EcoGoods MeasureType | The product template measure type (Fixed or Variable) | Mandatory | Integer | 1 - Fixed 2 - Variable CountryCode | The three digit country code of the origin location | Mandatory | String | AUS IsPublic | Specify the visibility of the product template | Mandatory | Boolean | True/False BrandOwnerId | The unique ID of the brand owner of the product. | Optional | String | ABN.123456789 ManufacturerId | The unique ID of the manufacturer of the product. | Optional | String | ABN.123456789 SubBrandName | The subsidiary of the brand name of the product or the sub-brand name. | Optional | String | Company ABC Black Steak ProductUses | The description of how the product is or can be used. | Optional | String | Ideal for outdoor activities, gym workouts, and daily hydration GS1 Classification | The common classification for grouping products.
  • Segment: An industry Segmentation or Vertical.
  • Family: A broad division of a segment.
  • Class: A group of like categories.
  • Brick: Categories of like products.
| Optional | Object |Example values:
  • Segment: Food/Beverage/Tobacco
  • Family: Beverages
  • Class: Non Alcoholic Beverages - Ready to Drink
  • Brick: Packaged Water
ProductAttributes | The detailed attributes of the product (fixed/variable, width, net weight, height, dimension, UoM, etc) | Optional | Object | 15 mm, 15 millimetre, 1L, 1 Litre MetadataFields | Additional metadata fields for the product template | Optional | Array |Array of custom metadata fields PackagingAndStorage | The product template specifications for packaging and storage (packaging type, temperature) | Optional | Object | Packaging type: Box Temperature: 20 Celsius OtherGeneral | The additional general product attributes - warranty description, warranty duration, warranty dates | Optional | Object | 3 years, 7 months, 30 days ProductDates | The product dates information (publication date, product lifespan from production time) | Optional | Object | PublicationDate: 01/01/2024

get.summary: Retrieve Product Templates/Materials Based on the Specified Filter
get.description:
### Retrieve Product Templates / Material / SKUs Based on the Specified Filter ###
            
This API allows users to get a list of all product templates, also known as materials, based on the specified filters.
            
The three filters are:
Field Name | Description | Data Type / Format | Example
---|---|---|---
archived | Specifies whether the product templates are archived or not. | String | Unarchived
visibility | Specifies whether the product templates are visible or not. | String | Public
getMyProductTemplates | Specifies whether to retrieve only the user's product templates or all the product templates. | Boolean | True
search | Specifies the string that must appear in the product template/material name in the response. | String | Tyres
limit | Specifies the maximum number of items or records that should be included in the response. | Integer(number) | 10
skip | specifies the offset or starting point from where the API should begin returning the results. It specifies the number of items or records that should be skipped or ignored before returning the requested data, and is useful for navigating to different pages or datasets in the result. | Integer(number) | 0
Therefore, a sample request specifying for:
* 10 entries in the response, AND
* with zero skipped entries, AND
* the search term is **Tyres**
            
will be written as the following:
            
    GET product-templates?search=Tyres&limit=10&skip=0;

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether the product templates are archived or not.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Whether the product templates are visible or not.

parameters.name: getMyProductTemplates
parameters.description: Whether to retrieve only the user's product templates or all the product templates.

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: The specific string to detect in the Product Template/Material name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of entries permitted in the response.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: The number of entries to skip in the response.

200.description: Returns the list of product templates/materials based on the provided filter
